name: flow_try_from_builders
description: B opens the Builders screen: the roster with my main and backup marked, the selected Builder in the arch with its role, passive and the checks it is strong and weak against, its kit on Q W E with the command tooltip (cost, numbers, both branches), and Main, Backup, Try. Choosing the backup as main swaps them. Try starts a solo practice match with that Builder at once (fielded as the build can show it) and its results lead back to the Builders screen; Esc goes back to the hub.

steps.assert: node('BuildersScreen').visible and not node('HubPanel').visible and Session.screen == 'builders'

steps.msg: the roster: my main and my backup marked, two sockets for Builders to come
my main in the arch, with its passive
the passive, the one line that explains her perk, shows whole, not cut mid-word
a roster cell selects its Builder
strong against Armored and Winged, weak against Swarm and Swift

steps.assert: node('TowerTip').visible and screen_has('Perch Ballista') and screen_has('(Q)') and screen_has('Pinning Ballista +')
steps.msg: the kit's tooltip: name, key, both branches
whether it reaches the sky, and the check a branch helps

steps.assert: Session.profile.main == 'lookout' and Session.profile.backup == 'lamplighter' and node('BuildersScreen').roster_lines() == ['lamplighter backup', 'lookout main', '', '']
steps.msg: the backup made main swaps the two
Try: a solo match with that Builder, offline, at once
after a Try, back to the Builders screen

steps.assert: node('HubPanel').visible and not node('BuildersScreen').visible and node('HubPanel').lines()[0] == 'diamond Sascha lookout'
steps.msg: Esc back to the hub, with the new main
